evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep said 'You can depend on this. Would take within the next five to ten minutes of your time. Would that be okay?' — framing present but slightly awkward wording and no explicit confirmation of price dependability; customer says 'Sure, sure. Yeah, that's great' which serves as a soft yes, not a firm confirmation.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Rep asked 'What are your biggest concerns or are there any important things that you wanted to answer during this call today?' — asked before probing started.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised 'a lot of stairs' as concern. Rep said 'Oh, okay. No worries. We'll go ahead and take note of that.' No follow-up question like 'tell me more about that' or exploration of how that impacts the move.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Rep gathered: property type (townhome), floors (3 story), bedrooms (3), additional room (garage, open area), parking access (driveway), walking distance (very close), access concerns (narrow stairs). Seven of seven logistics items covered.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Rep asked 'Do we have help in packing like putting the small items into your boxes like kitchen where schooling?' Customer clarified partial packing needed (kitchen, bookshelves, miscellaneous). Packing was offered and negotiated.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Rep said 'With regards to the number of your boxes, normally it would take 115 to 135 boxes. Do you feel that you fall within that range?' Customer said she had no idea and would move some items herself. Rep did not circle back with the overflow/special items check (china, book collections).
evidence_quotes.walkthrough_routing: Rep correctly identified 3700 sq ft destination home (over 1,800 sq ft threshold) and said 'So basically based on your home size normally we do a virtual walkthrough in that way, we will just base it on the items that we are moving. Do you have time to complete a virtual walkthrough today?' Customer agreed. Rep then created a FaceTime link and confirmed she was at the first location, transitioning to walkthrough. Call ends cleanly with walkthrough scheduled.

top_strength: Excellent logistics discovery — gathered all seven required details (property type, stories, bedrooms, additional rooms, parking, walking distance, access concerns) systematically and confirmed both locations' addresses and square footage.
coaching_note: When a customer raises a concern (stairs), dig deeper with a follow-up question like 'tell me more about that' rather than just acknowledging it — you only asked 'what are your biggest concerns' but never went two layers deep on the stair concern she raised.
